source: Allen Mouse Brain Connectivity Atlas, ProjectionStructureUnionize (is_injection=false, hemisphere=both). Oh et al. (2014), Nature 508:207-214.
corpus: Experiments reachable through service::mouse_connectivity_injection_structure with primary_structure_only — the same corpus the rest of BrainCAD works from. Rows from the Alzheimer, aged-cohort, retina and target-defined studies are left out rather than pooled into one connectome.
note: Per target structure, the strongest projection density reaching it from each other structure. One value per source, not per experiment, so the map shows anatomy rather than how often Allen injected a region. Self-projection and same-lineage pairs are excluded.
